meta.pitch: Pay carriers and owner-operators for every delivery that was confirmed with proof of delivery, with a bonus for arriving on time and for damage-free cargo.
meta.whoPays: A shipper, a broker or a 3PL that pays independent carriers
meta.signals: Delivery confirmed with proof of delivery, delivered inside the window, delivered without damage, delivery rejected or disputed - from a transport management system, a driver app or a spreadsheet export
meta.idea: The carrier is paid when the proof of delivery is in, not at the end of a 45-day invoice cycle. A small share is held in a damage-claims reserve and is released on a date, 15 days later, with no paperwork.
meta.limits: Harmony does not verify the proof of delivery, route, insure cargo or settle claims. The reserve is released by DATE, not by a claims decision: if a claim is upheld, handle it outside Harmony (the reserve cannot be taken back by the payer once it exists). Every count comes from a record somebody can edit, so review the events before paying.

program.name: Carrier proof of delivery
program.description: A rate per point, limited by a budget for the period, with a small damage-claims reserve released after the claims window.
